subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Which permanent Telegram album API should OpenClaw support for this issue: album semantics on the existing mediaUrls/send paths, the external draft's new send-media-group/filePaths action, or no native album feature for now?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but the model-facing action shape and cross-path delivery semantics are product/API decisions that should not be guessed by cleanup automation while an external draft with closing syntax is open.

options.title: Port album semantics onto mediaUrls
options.body: Use the existing structured mediaUrls/reply payload paths and add sendMediaGroup only as an eligible Telegram delivery optimization with sequential fallback.

options.title: Adopt the external draft action
options.body: Review and reshape the external draft's send-media-group/filePaths API as the supported model-facing action surface, accepting the extra action contract.

options.title: Defer native albums
options.body: Keep current sequential fanout as supported behavior and document that Telegram albums are not a current OpenClaw guarantee.

recommendation.title: Port album semantics onto mediaUrls
recommendation.body: Use the existing structured mediaUrls/reply payload paths and add sendMediaGroup only as an eligible Telegram delivery optimization with sequential fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses the shared message payload helper/API shape and the bundled Telegram plugin boundary, both connected to steipete's recent SDK/helper history and prior cleanup context.
